title: Normalize Todoist due verification and display errors
objective: Fix the exact write-path failure where intent 19:00 was compared with live 23:00 because a UTC Todoist due value was treated as a local wall time. Normalize fixed/UTC due values using the due timezone and zoneinfo; preserve floating local due semantics; fail closed when required zone data is missing; return structured mismatch data and format user-facing verification errors in 12-hour display.
diagnosis_used: FEEDBACK-21 handoff (authoritative): app/commit.py::_todoist_due_hhmm compared fixed UTC due.date wall time (23:00) directly to local intent HH:MM (19:00). Todoist fixed due.date is UTC; floating due.date is user-local. FEEDBACK-12 restored 12h visible display but raw verify_failures bypassed it.
acceptance_criteria_met: A 23:00Z due with America/New_York timezone verifies against 19:00 local intent: _todoist_due_reading converts UTC-anchored due.date through due.timezone via zoneinfo (23:00Z -> 19:00 EDT); test_fixed_utc_due_normalizes_through_due_timezone pins the exact Press repro and passes clean (verify_failures empty).

Floating/local Todoist due values remain local and verify correctly: an offset-less due.date (with or without a timezone field) passes through unchanged as the local wall time; test_floating_local_due_verifies_locally pins 19:00 floating vs intent 19:00 clean.

Missing/ambiguous timezone data fails closed with actionable structured error: a UTC-anchored due without due.timezone yields reason 'missing timezone for UTC due'; an unknown zone yields 'unknown timezone <tz>'; both recorded as structured verify_details with canonical live_raw/timezone, never a guessed zone (test_missing_timezone_on_utc_due_fails_closed, test_unknown_timezone_fails_closed).

Verification error UI displays 12-hour times while machine fields retain canonical ISO/timezone values: backend verify_failures strings are 12h ('7 PM', '11 PM', no raw 24h); new WriterResult.verify_details carry canonical 24h intent/live, raw ISO due.date, and IANA timezone; orchestrate aggregates them into the /commit response; wire.ts projects verifyDetails; ApprovalDrawer renders display12h from machine fields with raw ISO/timezone kept in the hover title.

Existing commit/write verification tests remain green; no live writes or commit: full backend suite 1306 passed, full frontend suite 576 passed | 6 skipped, typecheck clean, build:mockup + build:prod pass with bundle readback; safety_proof records zero live POSTs, provider writes, real source writes, restarts, and zero Git mutations.

changes.behavior: Add DueReading dataclass and _todoist_due_reading: UTC-anchored fixed dues (date ends in Z or carries an offset) convert through due.timezone via zoneinfo; floating offset-less dues pass through unchanged; all-day dues have no comparable time; missing/unknown timezone fails closed with an actionable error instead of guessing. _todoist_due_hhmm is now the normalized-local wrapper. Add _display12h (mirrors frontend display12h: '7 PM' / '7:30 PM' / em dash). WriterResult gains verify_details (machine-canonical records, lockstep with verify_failures) plus fail_due(); fail() appends a plain detail record so the two arrays stay aligned. Reconciliation loop in write_todoist uses the structured reading, records fail_due for mismatch/all-day/fail-closed, and formats user-visible messages in 12h.
_result_entry carries per-surface verify_details; top-level /commit report aggregates verify_details alongside verify_failures so machine-canonical values cross the wire to the frontend.

New TestDueVerificationNormalization class (7 tests): equivalent 23:00Z/19:00 encoding passes, floating local due passes, true mismatch fails with 12h message and no raw 24h, missing and unknown timezone fail closed, structured detail keeps canonical raw ISO/timezone/24h values, equivalent-vs-different instants are separate.
New test pins verify_details aggregation: canonical fields (intent 24h, live_raw, timezone, reason) travel in the report alongside the 12h display string; clean report keeps both arrays empty.
Add DueVerificationDetail (kind, name, intent, live, liveRaw, liveTimezone, reason, message — machine-canonical) and CommitReport.verifyDetails (optional).
projectCommitReport projects wire.verify_details into verifyDetails with canonical fields (live_raw -> liveRaw, live_timezone -> liveTimezone); absent for legacy payloads.

Verification failures render structured 'due' records as 12h via display12h(intent)/display12h(live), raw ISO/timezone in the hover title (matching the writeTarget raw-handle pattern); non-due failures render verbatim. Hoisted report const so TS narrows into the map callback.
2 new tests: canonical verify_details projection and legacy payload without verify_details.

2 new FEEDBACK-23 tests: structured due failure renders 'Press — due verification: intent 7 PM, live 11 PM' with no 19:00/23:00 visible and canonical raw ISO/timezone in title; plain failure renders verbatim.

preserved_semantics: Floating/local Todoist due semantics unchanged: offset-less wall times compare as-is.
Internal comparison and provider serialization never depend on display-formatted strings; _todoist_due_hhmm returns canonical 24h HH:MM.
Write path untouched: reschedule_task / reschedule_task_datetime call shapes and recurrence-preserving retime logic unchanged.
D1 per-write verification aggregation preserved: any verify_failures entry still blocks a bake-in PASS.
All-day intents, pinned recurring no-ops, and silent-drop/readback failure paths keep their existing behavior.
FEEDBACK-12 authority preserved: display12h is the only user-facing formatter; no display24h reintroduced.
